notes: τά before the substantival demonstrative is unrepresented and τοιαῦτα takes 'such things' headed on 'such' (rules 17, 49); the antecedent pronoun 'they' belongs to the other article, οἱ, under rule 32.
'with' realizes the dative government of συνευδοκοῦσιν and rides with the governed article, the ASV having written 'consent' as the compound's own verb word (rule 106's oblique arm).
The supplied object 'them' on the final participle is a rule 7 resumptive helper, which rule 103 names as the contrast to added lexical content.
